Multiple Drone Strikes and Missile Attacks Reported Across Ukraine and Russia

Multiple drone and missile attacks have occurred across Ukraine and Russia, resulting in civilian casualties and disruptions. In Ukraine, a Russian missile strike on a defense event killed 10 people, while another strike on a holiday camp in occupied Zaporizhzhia killed at least 12, including five children, with Moscow blaming Kyiv. Ukraine also reported Russian drone strikes killing three drivers at a courier firm. Meanwhile, Romania shot down a suspected Russian drone that breached its airspace. In Russia, drone threats disrupted operations at a Wildberries warehouse and an athletics championship in Yekaterinburg, and an oil refinery in Siberia was targeted by Ukrainian drones.
